release_ordering.scope: Ordering established from local hash-bound artifacts and timestamps plus launcher control flow, not adversarial secrecy, immutable timestamp or independent no-other-execution proof.

latency_and_resources.float_reconciliation_tolerance: Only different floating-point addition order in phase-sum seconds: absolute1e-12, relative1e-14; integer raw timing/allocations exact.

required_qualifiers: Bounded best-measured source/configuration slate, not global optimization or finite-protocol convergence.

July12 community GTFS deterministic phase0 frequency instances and conservative OSM walking model; not official/latest service, physical truth or passenger demand. Separate rail-interior hypothesis remains separate tune evidence.
Native2D,3D,arrival-topk,score cap-union and transfer-capped contracts remain distinct. Equal F[b] vectors do not imply equal walking-tie preference quality.
Ordinary RAPTOR control/candidate had source-differential and two-block tune qualification, not separate450 validation.

CSA arrival uses one strict identityk10 lane. CSA score uses union of boarding-cap0..4 lanes, eachk10/1m labels, then ranked score certificate; raw union may exceed10. Large evalkit does not certify strict identity top-k completeness; separate tiny/exhaustive qualification remains the evidence.

Quality is relative to the same incomplete observed witness pool/config. Zero observed regret or no feasible certificate counterexample is not proof of global completeness. Pool-empty rows remain unknown. Finite20 preference hypotheses are not learned rider preferences, welfare or demand.
Fresh processes and CPU0-3/GOMAXPROCS4 affinity do not establish exclusive cores or disk-cold cache. GOMEMLIMIT7GiB is soft; native7GB and sampled7.5GB RSS guards are not hard caps.
Single-pass empirical p99 values, especially90request/transit cohorts, are not production/population tails.

Explicit startup-phase sums and first setup-plus-response components exclude launch/prehash/gaps/serialization/transport, and are not complete process-cold first-byte latency. Cumulative heap/RSS snapshots must not be summed.
No raw GTFS/OSM, normalized datasets or binaries should be published. Only separately reviewed portable outcome projections may be shared; this acceptance is not license clearance.
publication_scope: Accepts evidence consistency for a bounded public-model outcome report with all qualifiers and unknowns retained; does not publish or authorize raw-data redistribution.
projection_scope: Compact user-facing evidence summary; no raw reviewer work files, private local paths or underlying data/witness databases. Full evidence remains hash-bound locally.
